name: sample-world
title: Emberfield
description: A demonstration world for the vefr engine. Replace everything.
gold_rule: Gold appears only when the world is kind.

phases.dusk: The day settles. The tone is quiet and watchful.
phases.dawn: The day begins. The tone is tentative and warm.

mother.strike: The bell has been struck. Write the goodbye: a letter left where only the right name will find it. Reply with only the JSON object.

given.prompt: given: handed over by expectation. It works. It fits badly.

found.prompt: found: made for her hands before she knew she needed them. Rare.

cold.card: A tool that does not care.
cold.prompt: cold: a tool. It simply works, for anyone.

bond_draw: Weight the random draw honestly: most are given or cold. Found is rare - maybe one in five. rarity is the point.
forge_texture: Items carry the world's texture. Curses are quiet, never gory - and a given item's curse is simply that it was never hers.
